title: Theory of Cells as Basic Units of Life
lineage: Institutional historical exhibit, not a transcription of the original research papers.

passages.note: The exhibit attributes plant and animal cellular accounts to Schleiden and Schwann, lists Schleiden 1838 and Schwann 1838–39, and distinguishes their proposals on cell formation from later cell division work.

file.method: Brief paraphrase of inspected source passages.
